chronology.stage_1: freeze the source, state bank, measurement, candidate-construction, training, and evaluation rules
chronology.stage_2: train three all-data probe policies and evaluate them on the fixed state bank
chronology.stage_3: qualify the failure signal and serialize candidate memberships, measurements, predictions, and hashes
chronology.stage_4: train and evaluate every unopened candidate arm and seed
chronology.stage_5: open candidate outcomes only after completeness and identity checks pass

state_bank.feature: initial square-nut x, y, cos(yaw), and sin(yaw)
state_bank.strata: eight cells formed by median splits of x, y, and angular offset from the nearest pi/2 symmetry

candidate_construction.coverage_objective: greedy weighted reduction in squared nearest-neighbor distance from frozen evaluation states to selected demonstration initial states
candidate_construction.distance: Euclidean distance after standardizing the four frozen initial-state features on the union of demonstrations and evaluation states
candidate_construction.short_pool: the 75 shortest demonstrations within each operator tier

candidates.construction: all demonstrations; reported as an opened measurement reference rather than an unopened candidate
tier-balanced greedy coverage with equal state weights
tier-balanced greedy coverage weighted by probe-policy failure probability
failure-weighted tier-balanced greedy coverage restricted to the shortest 75 demonstrations in each tier

decision.regression_prediction: candidate-by-stratum regression risk increases with the product of probe-policy failure probability and candidate coverage distance

training.hardware_rule: one fixed GPU type and software environment across all candidate runs

evaluation.secondary_outcome: candidate-minus-probe success change within each frozen state stratum

prohibitions: inspecting candidate-policy outcomes before the release gate passes
changing candidates, predictions, risk scores, or strata after candidate training begins
replacing failed seeds based on their outcomes
treating evaluation episodes as independent training interventions
